## Summary
Resideo Technologies is the home-comfort and security business spun off from Honeywell in October 2018, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona; it sells thermostats, cameras and leak detectors under the "Honeywell Home" name through a long-term licence from Honeywell, bought First Alert from Newell Brands in 2022, runs the ADI Global Distribution security wholesaler, and added Control4 when it agreed to buy Snap One for about $1.4 billion in April 2024 [1]. The IEEE registry lists six prefixes under "Resideo", at 2 Corporate Center Dr., Melville, New York; the oldest block, 00:D0:2D, dates from November 2000 and so predates the company name, with later blocks B8:2C:A0 (2011), 48:A2:E6 (2019) and the newest in June 2026 [2][3]. A MAC in one of these blocks on a home network is most likely a Wi-Fi thermostat: the T9 Smart Thermostat lists 802.11b/g/n on both the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz ranges [4]. No teardown, FCC grantee code or chipset documentation for the Honeywell Home thermostats was reachable in this session, so silicon and the FCC grantee are left unknown rather than guessed, and no vendor security advisories or MAC-randomization behaviour were found for these products.
